sentences: The single-lane model reads the attribute's own value for `v_interp_p1/p2`, which is only right when the VGPR source really holds the barycentric coordinate that op interpolates with — **p1 reads I = v0 and p2 reads J = v1, per op** — and `v_interp_mov_f32` models only the p0 provoking vertex.

A p1/p2 (f32 and f16 forms) whose source is not its own coordinate — v0 for p1, v1 for p2, each either the hardware register or a plain `v_mov_b32` copy rooted at it (the copy's single write in the whole shader, defined before the use, copy chains followed, and its source v0/v1 itself unwritten up to the copy: a copy of an already-overwritten v0/v1 carries a computed value — zeroing the source before copying renders (0,0) on hardware — while a write after the copy is fine, the copy saved the value) — is **Unsupported**, naming the register and the role, so a swapped p1(v1)/p2(v0) pair, a both-v0 pair, or a copy of an overwritten source is refused rather than silently mistranslated; `v_interp_mov_f32` with p10/p20 is **Unsupported**, naming the select.

A **direct** v0/v1 read stays accepted even when the shader overwrites v0/v1 first (evaluate-at-offset/snapped barycentrics; up to 213 PS, #1218): modelling that computed value is the separate provenance follow-up.

Zero corpus cost: over the 26,503-shader corpus every f32 I/J source is v0/v1 (117,001 / 116,997) except one PS whose four `v_interp_p2_f32` read J through `v_mov_b32 v14, v1` (its v1 unwritten up to the copy; the later overwrites are the saved-copy case), which the copy rule keeps translating (bit-identical .spv), every f16 source is v0/v1 (58,950 / 58,950), and all 6,926 `v_interp_mov_f32` use p0.

Confirmed by `tests/semantic/test_interp_guards.py` (refusals name the operand and its role, including swapped and both-v0 pairs, a wrong-root copy, and a copy of an overwritten source; the copy, copy-chain, matching-role and saved-from-later-zero cases translate and compute; a second write or a dpp copy no longer qualifies; a mutation check that the guard consults the copy analysis) and by re-translating a 200-shader corpus slice plus that PS before and after: translated/valid counts and every .spv unchanged.
